_readme: Classifies each skill's deferred content (reference(s)/scripts/assets) for skill_budget_audit.py's Typical Call estimate. 'deferred-alternatives' = a menu of mutually-exclusive options where a normal call loads roughly one (Typical Call = largest single deferred file). 'deferred-full-use' = cumulative/sequential content that normally all loads together, e.g. a build-script checklist (Typical Call = Worst Case). Skills not listed here default to deferred-full-use until reviewed -- add an entry with a reason to reclassify.

sounding-board.reason: Each references/*.md is a distinct audience persona; a prompt typically engages one audience, occasionally a few more for an explicit 'panel' request, but never realistically all seven at once.

signatry-icons.reason: assets/icons/svg/ is a 69-file library searched via scripts/find_icons.py; a normal task needs one or a small handful of icons, not the whole set.

signatry-facts.reason: reference/*.md files are topic-gated (fees, figures, history, stories, products, assets, named-things); most content tasks need one or two topics, not all seven.

signatry-brand-core.reason: Logo files are use-case-specific (light vs. dark background, full wordmark vs. quill-only) -- a build needs the one matching its context, not all of them; reference/tints.md is loaded only when a specific tint value is actually needed.

signatry-style.reason: Both reference files are narrow-trigger (scripture citation, extended donor narrative) -- most pieces need zero or one, not both.

signatry-photo-library.reason: references/placement-rules.md is only needed when actually placing an image, not when searching or shortlisting -- a search-only task doesn't load it at all.

signatry-resource-library.reason: reference/maintenance.md documents a scheduled maintenance cycle explicitly described as not part of ordinary use -- a normal donor-resource lookup doesn't load it.

signatry-pptx-brand.reason: scripts/ are sequential steps in this skill's own 'Definition of done' checklist and run on every build; the bundled logo assets and design-system.md are required reading/assets for any deck, not just some.
